milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the purple banner marking the building entrance. The player must be within 16 blocks and facing toward the banners above the doorway. Target is the center banner at spawn-relative (1, 3, 3). Max distance 16 allows detection from spawn position; facing_tolerance 60 ensures the player is looking at the entrance.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the potted red tulip inside the building. The player must navigate inside and be within 8 blocks while facing the tulip. Target is at spawn-relative (1, 1, 7) in the center of the room. Max distance 8 requires entering the building; facing_tolerance 60 ensures the player is looking at it.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind='block', max_count=0) because mining cyan stained glass without Silk Touch does not drop the item into inventory (so inventory_has won't work). Instead we verify all glass blocks have been removed from their original position in the left wall. The box covers the 3-block column at spawn-relative x=-3, y=1-3, z=6 with a generous margin (±2 XZ, ±1 Y).

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the orange glazed terracotta tiles on the floor in the back-right corner of the building. The player must navigate to the back of the room and face the terracotta. Target is the center of the cluster at spawn-relative (3, 0, 9). Max distance 8 requires being inside the building; facing_tolerance 60 ensures the player is looking at the tiles.
